item.title: HoloDesk 0.1.0
item.description:
# HoloDesk for Mac
The initial public release of HoloDesk for Apple Silicon Macs.
- Native canvas browsing with independent pages and a persistent workspace. - Local password saving, updating, filling and management. - Signed automatic updates, with Check for Updates in the HoloDesk menu.
Open the DMG, drag HoloDesk to Applications, then open HoloDesk. Existing installations without automatic updates need this manual installation once; later releases can update through the app.
